pages.text: Well hello, dear! &6Mabel Thornfield&r. Don't mind the mud, it's the good kind.
&6Farming&r is crops. Harvest wheat, carrots, potatoes, melons and the rest, and you gain &6Farming XP&r. Only fully grown crops count, mind. Replant and the field pays you back, season after season.

Higher levels give you &6Farming Fortune&r, which means more crops per swing. Every trade gives stats as you level; you can see them all on your Profile page. Here's a hoe, and a few carrots to plant.
